description: Power System Multi-source Events Dataset is a data set deposited in IEEE DataPort by its authors Jingsong Wang. "This dataset provides graph-structured time-series measurements for power system multi-source event detection, localization, and classification (ED-L-C). Generated from the IEEE 34 Node Test Feeder via electromagnetic transient simulation, it contains 7,500 samples, each consisting of 120 Hz PMU recordings across 34 nodes with 9 feature channels (three-phase voltage magnitudes, current magnitudes, and power factor cosines). Coverage: not stated; the metadata date the deposit to 2026. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge, and IEEE DataPort normally asks for a free account before download (not tested). The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support power-system, energy-planning and grid-operation studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-ieeedp-repository.
